newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - HUHTAMAKI 4-MTH PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - HUHTAMAKI 4-MTH PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 125 million markka median
forecast for Finnish confectionery and packaging group
Huhtamaki Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items
and tax.
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (FIM)
Median 125 3.4
Mean 123 3.6
Lowest 90 3.3
Highest 160 4.6
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by five analysts).
Huhtamaki's four-month results are due on June 10 at
In January-April 1996, Huhtamaki posted a profit before
extraordinaries and tax of 108 million markka.
In March, Huhtamaki said the company's upward profit trend
had been reinstated.
The median of 10 analysts' forecasts for Huhtamaki's
full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 591 million
markka (mean 582 million) in a 509-635 million markka range.
In 1996, Huhtamaki's profit was 416 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities,
Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM
Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities,
Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
